questions.q: What is the programme mainly about?
options: How the Romans studied the stars and planets
Mars: why it's red and if it could support life
Famous songs and films about outer space
How to see planets at night without a telescope
questions.why: They discuss what gives Mars its colour and the biggest question: is there life on Mars?

questions.q: What does Neil give as examples of art inspired by Mars?
options: Ancient Roman paintings and statues
Maya poems about the night sky
Photographs taken by NASA scientists
A David Bowie song and several films
questions.why: He mentions David Bowie's 'Life on Mars?' and films like 'Mars Attacks!' and 'The Martian'.

questions.q: What did ancient civilisations like the Maya do?
options: Watched Mars and recorded its movements
Sent people to explore the surface of Mars
Believed that Mars was covered in water
Named Mars after their own god of fire
questions.why: Sam says the Maya observed the planet's colour and recorded its movements, like modern astronomers.

questions.q: According to Dr Michael Meyer, why does Mars look red?
options: It is very hot, like fire
Light from the Sun is red there
There is rust on its surface
Its clouds are full of red dust
questions.why: He says it looks red because of rust – iron oxide on the surface.

questions.q: What happened to Mars's appearance in 2018?
options: It looked much bigger in the night sky
It disappeared from view for several months
It turned completely white because of ice
It looked a little orange after a dust storm
questions.why: He says in 2018 there was a global dust storm and Mars looked a little orange instead of red.

questions.q: Why might Mars's changing colour have worried ancient civilisations?
options: They thought it meant a war was coming
They thought the night sky never changed
They thought Mars was moving closer to Earth
They believed it would destroy their crops
questions.why: Dr Meyer says they may have been uneasy to see something 'immutable' in the night sky changing colour.

questions.q: According to Dr Meyer, why is finding water on Mars so important?
options: Life can adapt, but it still needs water
Water could be used as fuel for rockets
Water would change the planet's colour
Astronauts need water to grow food there
questions.why: He says life is amazingly adaptable 'but it still needs water', so water means a possibly habitable place.

questions.q: What does Sam suggest about humans going to Mars?
options: Humans have already walked on Mars several times
Scientists have decided it is far too dangerous
Businessmen like Elon Musk plan to send people
Only robots will ever be able to go there
questions.why: She says billionaire businessmen like Elon Musk are planning manned missions to space.
